news.headline: A Rare Supermoon Is Coming on Christmas Eve
news.body: On December 24 there will be a full Moon that is closer to Earth than usual, called a supermoon. It can look up to 14% brighter and 30% bigger than a normal full Moon. A Christmas Eve full Moon this close to Earth has not happened in over 200 years!

news.headline: Women's World Cup 2035 Is Heading to the UK
news.body: England, Northern Ireland, Scotland and Wales were named joint hosts of the 2035 Women's World Cup. The tournament will have 48 teams and 104 matches over 39 days. Young players are already excited to watch!
